## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Bǎoshòu púsà pútí xíng jīng* (T488) is a one-fascicle late Mahāyāna sūtra translated by [法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2) Fǎxián (the Sòng imperial-renamed [天息災](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A9%E6%81%AF%E7%81%BD) Tiānxīzāi, d. 1000 CE) at the Sòng *Yìjīng yuàn* 譯經院. The protagonist *Bǎoshòu* 寶授 ("Treasure-Conferral"; Sanskrit *Ratnadatta*) is the bodhisattva interlocutor.

**Abstract**

This is a brief Sòng-period Mahāyāna text on the bodhisattva's practice (*bodhicaryā*). Fǎxián's translation activity post-987 CE (after his name change) is dated 989–1000 CE. The text is structured as a dialogue between the bodhisattva *Ratnadatta* and the Buddha on the proper conduct of the bodhisattva path.
